## 🚀 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see added to Trader Vaults.

## 🎯 Problem Statement
What problem does this feature solve? What pain point does it address?

## 💡 Proposed Solution
A clear description of what you want to happen.

## 🎨 User Interface
If applicable, describe or mock up the user interface changes.

## 📊 Use Cases
Describe specific use cases for this feature.

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 📈 Impact
How will this feature improve the Trader Vaults platform?

## 🚧 Implementation Details (Optional)
If you have thoughts on how this could be implemented, include them here.

## 📝 Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, or examples about the feature request here.
